question: I booked an Ottawa visit in mid-February and want to skate on the Rideau Canal. Can you guarantee the Skateway will be open because February is winter?
generated_answer: A: The National Capital Commission (NCC) is responsible for the maintenance of the Rideau Canal Skateway. The NCC website has information on the current status of the Skateway. The NCC also has a Skateway hotline: 613-239-5000. The NCC does not guarantee that the Skateway will be open. The Skateway is open when weather conditions permit. The Skateway is usually open from late December to mid-March, but the exact dates vary from year to year. The NCC makes every effort to keep the Skateway open for as long as possible, but the weather can be unpredictable. The NCC may need to close the Skateway due to weather conditions, such as heavy snowfall or extreme cold. The NCC will post updates on the Skateway's status on their website and social media channels. It is also a good idea to check the weather forecast before planning your visit to the Skateway.
